title: Travel and Holidays

story.title: Our first trip abroad
story.text: Last summer, my family decided to **go on holiday** **abroad** for the first time. We chose Turkey! My mum **booked a hotel** online two months before, and Dad bought the **tickets**. The night before the trip, we **packed** our **luggage** – my sister wanted to take all her toys! | We went to the **airport** **by car**. Dad couldn’t find his **passport** for ten minutes – we were so nervous! We **left** at 6 a.m. and **arrived** in Istanbul at 9. | We **stayed** in Istanbul for three days. We **went sightseeing** and **visited** old mosques and markets. On the second day, we **got lost** in the small streets, but a kind man helped us. | Then we **took a trip** to Antalya **by train** and bus. We swam at the **beach** every day and **explored** the **mountains** near the town. | There were **tourists** from many countries. | Before we went home, I bought **souvenirs** for my friends. It was the best holiday ever!

answers: Do you prefer the beach or the mountains?
**I prefer** mountain **holidays because** it’s cool and quiet there. **For example**, last year we **stayed** in Chimgan **for** four **days** and walked every day.
What places should tourists visit in your country?
They should **visit** Samarkand and Bukhara. There are beautiful old buildings, and the food is delicious. **It was amazing** for me when I went there.
speech: Hello! I want to tell you about my last trip. **Last summer I went to** Bukhara with my classmates. **We went there by** train **and it took** about four hours. **We stayed at** a small family hotel **for** three **days**. We went sightseeing every day and visited old mosques and madrasas. We also bought souvenirs at the market. **The best thing about the trip was** the evening walks in the old city – it was beautiful with all the lights. **It was amazing!** **I’d love to visit** Japan **one day**. Thank you for listening!
